column1: # p429 · 2026-10-25 · THE TWO COHORTS THIS PASS MEASURED, every address read FIRST-HAND at the SHA on 2026-10-25.
# Legs: GitHub repository search `google classroom mcp` sorted by `updated` desc (total_count=37, all 37 read) and
# `blackboard learn mcp` (total_count=10, all 10 read).  Both cohorts resolve 47/47 under `git ls-remote` — no credential prompt, no gone address.
# family is read FROM THE PAYLOAD at that SHA, never from GitHub's licence field; api_license is GitHub's own field, recorded only so the two can be compared.
# sha256_12 is the first 12 hex of sha256 over the licence payload AS COMMITTED at that SHA.  bytes is that payload's length.
# 🔴 Where family and api_license disagree, the PAYLOAD governs: see pengusto/google-classroom-mcp, whose api_license is NOASSERTION and whose payload is a commercial licence.
